- **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers ref (Bugwood_13)**: **Direct microscopy match** — same multi-septate, club-shaped, beige Alternaria conidia at similar scale.
- **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch ref**: Field photo of circular leaf spots — no match.
- **Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers ref (Bugwood_4)**: Field photo of stem canker — shows the macroscopic form of the same disease class.

The Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers class clearly includes Bugwood microscopy images (like Bugwood_13) showing identical conidia to the test image. The spore morphology matches Alternaria species: elongated body, multiple transverse septa, tapering beak. This aligns best with Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers.
